name: International Company of Cuban Dances
description: Afro-Cuban folkloric dance company and academy led by former dancers of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba. Training weekends every month in a different European city.

announcement.text: 🎉 4 years of ICCD! Celebrate our anniversary with us at the Spijkenisse training, 10–11 October

hero.title: Learn folkloric & popular dances from Cuba
hero.text: Taught by former dancers of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba. One weekend a month, each time in a different European city, with live drums and singing.

intro.title: Who we are
intro.text: ICCD was founded in 2022 by former dancers and teachers of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba. Today it brings together dancers from all over Europe. We train together every month, perform Cuban folkloric dance on stage and pass on what the maestros teach us.

tagline: Come for the dance. Stay for the people.

family.title: One company, many countries
family.text: We are dancers from more than fifteen countries. Once a month we travel to a different city, share a studio for a weekend, eat together, and go home tired and happy. What started as classes has turned into friendships across Europe. We are here to learn, to perform, and to share Cuban music and dance.
